question: In which of the following cities is the Headquarters of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__New Delhi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Panchayati Raj**

 
 
• The **Headquarters **of the **Ministry of Panchayati Raj **is located in **New Delhi**.
 
• One of the departments of the** Indian government** is the** Ministry of Panchayati Ra**j. All issues involving** Panchayati Raj **and **Panchayati Raj Institutions** are investigated by the** Ministry of Panchayati Raj**.
 
• The ministry, which distributes payments to rural local authorities for **civic activities** including **maintaining **and** building roads**, **pavements**, **bridges**, etc., is led by a **minister of cabinet rank** or** Minister of State**.
 
• An expert group was established by the** Ministry of Panchayati Raj** in **June 2007** NIC, Government of India, Director General **Dr B.K. Gairola** is in charge.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **New Delhi**

 
 
• The **National Capital Territory **of Delhi includes New Delhi, the capital of India** (NCT)**. The** Rashtrapati Bhavan**,** Parliament House**, and the** Indian Supreme Court** are all located in **New Delhi**, which serves as the home of all three branches of the **Indian governmen**t.
 
• The** NDMC** is in charge of running New Delhi, a municipality in the NCT that mostly encompasses **Lutyens**' Delhi and a few nearby localities.
 
• Both the municipality and the **New Delhi district** make up a very minor portion of the megacity of **Delhi**, which is referred to as the **National Capital Territory of Delhi **and can be referred to by the names **Delhi **or** New Delhi** interchangeably.
